freshCityLocalSearch.summary: Fresh official sources confirm GeoSenegal’s Dakar ND-28-XIX offering is 1:200,000 topographic KML/SHP from ANAT, not parcel geometry. The national geodata catalog describes normalized vectors and imagery, not a parcel feature API. DGID NICAD instructions route parcel-plan extracts through the local Cadastre bureau with title/allocation and plan documentation; no anonymous feature endpoint is documented. Direct ordinary-host HTTPS to the exact old georepertoire cadastral-plan record timed out and HTTP reset. The currently operating GeoSenegal catalog and Dakar sheet pages return HTTP 200. No target bbox query was possible because no parcel feature endpoint was found.
